lines.text: The tribe of Levi has no inheritance with Israel, so the priests eat the food offerings and receive the shoulder, jowls, and stomach.
A Levite who comes in all earnestness to the place the LORD will choose serves there and eats equal portions.
Israel must not imitate the nations, who sacrifice children in the fire and consult mediums, because the LORD is driving them out.
Moses says the LORD will raise up a prophet like him, and the people asked for this at Sinai.
A prophet whose message does not come true has spoken presumptuously, and a prophet who speaks in the name of other gods must be exiled.
